crossRefs.note: The king said, “Inquire whose son the young man is!”

translations.web: The king said, “Inquire whose son the young man is!”
translations.bsb: “Find out whose son this young man is!” said the king.
translations.kjv: And the king said, Enquire thou whose son the stripling is.
translations.asv: And the king said, Inquire thou whose son the stripling is.
